name: Herald of Purity's Justice reset reaches the client after the cast (#12605)
contract: Herald of Purity 806058 reads 'Damage dealt by Justice now has an 8% chance to reset its own cooldown.' Justice
520359 deals no damage itself: its main-hand and off-hand strikes 524857 and 572040 are TRIGGER_SPELL effects,
which Spell::EffectTriggerSpell runs in the launch phase, after SMSG_SPELL_COOLDOWN and before Justice's
SMSG_SPELL_GO. The handler cleared the cooldown right away, so its SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN reached the client before
the SMSG_SPELL_GO that starts the client's own cooldown: the server cooldown was reset (#9129 passes) but the
button kept its full 8 sec (#12605, 132 hits without one visible reset). The reset now runs on the player's next
update, after the cast. The cast loop of sun-cleric-herald-of-purity-justice-reset-9129 is kept at level 60: 270
attempts every 1650 ms with two strikes per cast at 8%, where 54 casts complete without a reset and all 54 miss
every reset with probability about 0.012%. A clear sent before a cast's SMSG_SPELL_GO is undone by that GO, so
under the old order every cast a reset allowed reached the client while it still showed the 8 sec cooldown:
client_cooldown_blocked_casts counts those casts and must stay 0 while more than 54 casts complete.
